title: ASF Public School Rawalpindi, Rawalpindi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: ASF Public School Rawalpindi, located in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Address: Khawaja Road, Walton, Punjab, Askari 5.
